description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per challenge - the payment buys one signed facilitator fit check for the challenge you submit: its named facilitator's /supported graded live as served (serves-kind / testnet-only / does-not-serve), all factors printed, guarantees exactly as published or their absence, and the PayAI free-credit state when the named facilitator is PayAI (otherwise NOT-PUBLISHED).

facilitator_url.description: The facilitator base URL whose /supported is graded; the host is reported, the path is never stored.

payTo.description: Optional seller wallet; required for the PayAI free-credits leg when the named facilitator is PayAI.

name: facilitator_fit_check
